title: The printer takes the print job into the queue but doesn't print it
description: 5 of my documents have piled up in the print queue, none of them print. There's no error showing on the printer.

worklogs.description: The Print Spooler service was restarted and the queue was cleared.
A test page was printed and it works.

comments.author: agent
comments.message: I restarted the print spooler and cleared its queue. You can resend your documents.

resolutionNote: The Windows Print Spooler service was restarted and the queue was cleared. Printing is normal.

csat.comment: It was fast, but this issue could happen again.
